title: North Dakota Century Code Chapter 52-06 - Benefits
verified_how: fetched the register's Title 52 chapter index (https://ndlegis.gov/cencode/t52.html): title 'Title 52 - Social Security', chapter row '52-06' with name 'Benefits', no '[Repealed]' marker (siblings 52-06.1, 52-07, 52-09 and 52-12 are marked [Repealed]); then fetched https://ndlegis.gov/cencode/t52c06.html, which lists sections from 52-06-01. Currency: 07/01/25 update, 69th Legislative Assembly.
notes: Unemployment compensation benefit entitlement, eligibility and disqualification - the most rule-dense everyday benefit statute in the Century Code. Means-tested public assistance sits in Title 50 (Public Welfare), principally ch. 50-09 (Aid to Dependent Children) and ch. 50-24.1 (Medical Assistance for Needy Persons), both verified in force on https://ndlegis.gov/cencode/t50.html but not listed because only one statute per topic is recorded.
